explication: Pulumi is an infrastructure-as-code platform comprising the CLI, language SDKs, and core engine. The principal workflow is: a user creates a project and writes a program, invokes an operation such as `pulumi up`, and the engine evaluates the desired resources, coordinates providers, and records stack state; the CLI then presents results. The README documents broad language and cloud-provider support, while the tree shows backend, state, display, and ESC command subsystems. Sampled source confirms the engine operation context and plugin-to-engine RPC, but not every runtime connection, so uncertain links are omitted.
